headline: Kenya's Nairobi Expressway Recorded $39.5 Million Net Loss in 2025
summary: A National Treasury report revealed that Moja Expressway spent $114.1 million against $74.6 million in revenue during 2025, resulting in a $39.5 million shortfall while the state holds contract termination liabilities.
why: Toll road concessions backed by sovereign guarantees pose contingent liability risks for emerging-market public finances when operational revenue lags costs.
